SC6 — the hole triptych: three absences that must not share a face

Treatments adapted from: Leiden lacuna-with-counted-extent (H7), the hydrographic unsurveyed area + Glomar non-answer (H8), the Leiden vacat (H9). Authored monochrome; every distinction is structural.

g.text: A. H7 — missing referent: a lacuna with an identity

two fragments — the connection, if any, is inside the lacuna; drawing a bridge would manufacture an edge
ECR-role claim · Jordan Q. Fixture · Compliance Analyst

B. H8 — hidden destination: a Glomar answer, drawn as unsurveyed margin
fixtures: compact_private_edge (one named slot), blinded_edge_group (whole section compact)
UNSURVEYED — destinations committed, not shown; coincidences unknowable
e: 1 edge · slot "source" · edge block compact
‡ destination withheld — there is no SAID to name (contrast †, panel A)
destination: not in this presentation · op: undetermined
a.label: "presenting node with a wholly hidden edge-group"
e — section compact: ECoh63QG… · edge count unknown
one stub for the whole section — its size says nothing about how many edges hide
The edge is never dropped and no far node is ever drawn: a committed relationship terminates in a region, not a place.
The entry gate is fixed-size regardless of what hides behind it (Lopresti–Spitz: a marker's geometry must not leak).
C. H9 — committed no-edge: a vacat, sealed and measured — beside its control
fixtures: optional_edge_absent (H9) · optional_edge_present (control; its far node is out of hand → a lacuna, so H9 and H7 sit side by side)
a.claim: "a claim issued with no endorsement attached"
vacat — no edge section in this credential, as issued
committed by d · not a claim about the world (Rule 13)
6: no subject — no edge exists to check
nothing dangles in graph space: there is no hole to draw, and drawing one would lie
a.claim: "a claim with an attached endorsement"
op: undetermined — o unspecified, far node unresolved (Rule 9b)
referent named; artifact not in this presentation
The pair Leiden was built for: "nothing was ever
here" (vacat, sealed blank, inside the card) can
never share a face with "something is here and is
not in hand" (lacuna, bracketed hatch, in graph space).
D. Two blinded edges — convergence itself unknowable
fixtures: two_blinded_edges_converge / two_blinded_edges_diverge — structurally identical by design
The two renders above are the same drawing.
Each blinded edge ends at its own fixed-size gate into one shared unsurveyed region, inside which nothing is drawn.
Whether the two destinations coincide is neither depicted nor deniable: the region carries the question, unanswered.
Ground truth (converge vs diverge) is not renderable information — H8's "cannot know" column — so it does not render.
Precedent crossed here, stated plainly: no surveyed discipline grades the destination of a relationship. The unsurveyed
area is a region-of-space convention; this panel reuses it as a region-of-topology. The band is not a place, and the
label must carry that weight — this is adaptation past the edge of the evidence, per precedent-for-absence.md §"what does not transfer".
Legend — three absences, three structures (pairwise distinct in shape, position, and prose; no colour used anywhere)
bracketed, hatched, a place in the graph; blocking SAID named.
the edge ends in a region, not a place; fixed gate, empty interior.
sealed blank inside the card; the enclosing SAID commits to it.

V-cell key: ▫· unperformed (drawn, never blank) · ▫/ unperformable (dagger names the blocker) · no fail glyph exists in this render — no host declared a fail-capable check (Rule 2c). Checks 1–9: SAID, schema, signature, KEL-anchor, delegation, edge-constraint (per edge), issuer bona fides, revocation, duplicity.
